name: forest_asset_pack_v2
source: Generated original sprites. ideal.png was used only as a visual direction reference; no pixels were copied or cropped.
purpose: ForestMassOverlay condition-driven asset pack for map edge/mid/deep forest rendering.
coverage_target: Covers common forest edge/mass conditions detected in forest_edge_condition_matrix_v1.json.

usage_notes.z_sort: Use bottom-center anchor for object ordering. Ground/shadow overlays use center anchors.
usage_notes.bounds: Apply map_border_guard before picking large clusters.
usage_notes.zones: Pick by condition first, then zone fallback: edge -> mid -> deep.
usage_notes.final_render: This pack is intended for experimental overlay first, not immediate gameplay/collision changes.
